crime: A stone column rose from the middle of the courtyard fountain as its spout. Every dusk, a girl pitched fifty stones at it, keeping her old pitching arm in shape. {WITCH_NAME} stood across the basin and, with her Magic, became the girl's reflection: she wound up as the girl wound up, threw as she threw, and her stones flew as true as the girl's. On her own, she could not throw straight.
One dusk, the girl rubbed her worn-out shoulder and said tonight's fifty would be her last. "Throw on your own tomorrow. The column will still be there."
{WITCH_NAME}'s father had played catch with her only on the evenings he came home. One evening he handed her the ball and left. "Throw it at the wall. The wall is always there." He never came back.

Before the last pitch, she planted her feet just beside the spot she had worn into the path, out of line with the column. The girl threw, and {WITCH_NAME} threw as her mirror. The stone flew past the column and struck the girl in the temple.
From the upper railing, the prisoners heard one knock, as on every evening, and saw the girl snap back and fall. She lay still by the basin, a single stone beside her head.

In the trial court, the prisoners assumed the girl's own stone had glanced off the column and hit her. After all, the mirror's stone always met the column. Then a prisoner noticed fresh footprints on the path beside {WITCH_NAME}'s worn spot, and none beside the girl's. The prisoners realized that {WITCH_NAME} had stepped to one side, so that her mirrored throw would miss the column.
fields.epitaph: The only throw she ever made on her own was where she chose to stand.
fields.epithet: The Reflection That Never Throws First
execution: The execution stand raises a tall wall of stacked stone before her, her feet sunk to the ankles in packed earth at its foot. Slowly, the wall leans down onto her. She presses her palms flat against it and pushes back. The wall keeps coming until it lies flat and still over her, and her palms no longer push.

magic.name: Living Mirror
magic.text: She moves in perfect unison with anyone she watches, their living mirror, skill and all.
